description: This file defines the interface and class for the calculator engine CCalcEngine, including its methods, member variables, and related enums and namespaces. It sets up the structure for processing calculator commands, display management, and internal state handling.

classes.name: CCalcEngine
classes.description: Main calculator engine class managing calculation state, command processing, display updates, and internal logic.

classes.name: CalculationManager::IResourceProvider
classes.description: Interface for resource provisioning within the calculation manager.

methods.name: CCalcEngine
methods.description: Constructor initializing the calculator engine with configuration flags and resource/display pointers.

methods.name: ProcessCommand
methods.description: Processes a calculator command identified by OpCode.

methods.name: DisplayError
methods.description: Displays an error message based on error code.

methods.name: PersistedMemObject
methods.description: Returns the current memory object as a Rational pointer.

methods.name: PersistedMemObject(CalcEngine::Rational const&)
methods.description: Sets the memory object to the provided Rational value.

methods.name: FInErrorState
methods.description: Checks if the engine is in an error state.

methods.name: IsInputEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the current input is empty or zero.

methods.name: FInRecordingState
methods.description: Checks if the engine is in recording mode.

methods.name: SettingsChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when settings are changed.

methods.name: IsCurrentTooBigForTrig
methods.description: Determines if current value exceeds trig limits.

methods.name: GetCurrentRadix
methods.description: Returns the current radix/base.

methods.name: GetCurrentResultForRadix
methods.description: Gets the current calculation result formatted for a specific radix.

methods.name: ChangePrecision
methods.description: Changes the precision and updates related constants.

methods.name: GroupDigitsPerRadix
methods.description: Formats number string with digit grouping per radix.

methods.name: GetStringForDisplay
methods.description: Converts Rational to display string based on radix.

methods.name: UpdateMaxIntDigits
methods.description: Updates maximum integer digit count.

methods.name: DecimalSeparator
methods.description: Returns the decimal separator character.

methods.name: GetHistoryCollectorCommandsSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of history commands.

methods.name: InitialOneTimeOnlySetup
methods.description: Performs one-time setup for shared resources.

methods.name: GetString
methods.description: Retrieves string representation for command IDs or string views.

methods.name: OpCodeToString
methods.description: Converts an OpCode to its string representation.

methods.name: OpCodeToUnaryString
methods.description: Converts an OpCode to its unary string form.

methods.name: OpCodeToBinaryString
methods.description: Converts an OpCode to its binary string form.
